teaser: Three cars sit in the trailhead parking lot at dawn, engines off, and you are the one who got there first, again. Life path 7 and INTJ meet in exactly this: the pull toward solitude, the mind that would rather map the terrain alone than ask directions from the group. The 7 wants a private reckoning with what is true; the INTJ wants a private model of how things work. Set side by side, they do not compete, they double down. What is particular to you is how rarely either half of this needs company to feel complete, and how much gets built in the hours nobody else sees.
